project: Direct Internet Method universal installation engine
scope: Linux x86_64 read-only FD-bound protected source verifier, not privileged broker or installation

source_code_contract.parent_walk: O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC with os.open(dir_fd=...) plus fstat of each held directory descriptor from / through protected root; UID0 and no group/other write required
source_code_contract.nested_member_walk: All intermediate member directories opened by dirfd and verified UID0 / mode nonwritable before member open
source_code_contract.file_resolution: Linux kernel syscall openat2 (x86_64 number 437), RESOLVE_BENEATH|RESOLVE_NO_SYMLINKS|RESOLVE_NO_MAGICLINKS; fail closed on unsupported kernel
source_code_contract.member_validation: file descriptor fstat must be UID0, regular, no group/other write, expected exact bytes and SHA256, stable dev/inode/size/mtime_ns/ctime_ns across read; never reopen path by name

linux_emad_native.positive_exercise: read pinned immutable public GPL-3 bytes via OS FD relative to protected root and nested /usr/share; verify exact length/digest
negative_exercises: file descriptor remains anchored to same inode after a user-owned directory is renamed

github_ephemeral_root_owned_ci.condition: push to feature/universal-install-engine only; not pull_request

limits: Open file handles are only read-only primitives; they are not an OS privilege grant

No actual DIM package upgrade, physical VM power loss or signed release acceptance
